  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_tut_pyro_nathan_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Roasted Zombie. The smell is worse than the look.<en> Game text Roasted zombie. The smell is worse than the look.
<en> Tutorial: rest (2)
  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_tut_rest_nathan_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll sleep like the dead. Just not literally.<en> Game text I'll sleep like the dead. Just not literally.

<en> Unarmed at a door (2)
  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_unarmed_door_nathan_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Sturdy. Not without a weapon.<en> Game text Sturdy. Not without a weapon.
  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_unarmed_door_nathan_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hands are useless here. I need a club or an axe.<en> Game text Hands are useless here. I need a club or an axe.
<en> Unarmed at a door (<en> generic) (2)
  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_unarmed_door_generic_01@nathan.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Fists won't break this door.
  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_unarmed_door_generic_02@nathan.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll just hurt my hands. I need a weapon.
<en> Unarmed at glass (2)
  • नेथन कोलloc_chatter_unarmed_glass_nathan_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll slice my hand open. Weapon first.<en> Game text I'll slice my hand open. Weapon first.

<en> Unarmed at glass (<en> generic) (2)

<en> Story dialogue (711)

Quest ending acceptance: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_ending_acceptance.end.later.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need to think. Let's come back to this conversation later.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_ending_acceptance.end.ready.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My daughter is dead. I won't bring her back by force. Nora has the right to be herself.
Quest ending body: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_ending_body.end.later.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need to think. Let's come back to this conversation later.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_ending_body.end.ready.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I accept a finite life and a single core. No spare noras.
Quest ending consent: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_ending_consent.end.later.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Give me a little time. I won't touch your decision. I need to learn to accept it.
  • नेथन कोल→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_ending_consent.end.ready.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hear you. You don't have to be her. The transfer will be exactly what you chose, and not one step further.
Quest ending evacuation: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_ending_evacuation.end.later.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need to think. Let's come back to this conversation later.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_ending_evacuation.end.ready.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I approve the route for everyone. We leave no one at the core.
Quest ending evidence: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_ending_evidence.end.later.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need to think. Let's come back to this conversation later.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_ending_evidence.end.ready.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I acknowledge the risk to other worlds. We'll keep both independent reports.
Quest ending transfer: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_ending_transfer.end.later.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need to think. Let's come back to this conversation later.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_ending_transfer.end.ready.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll sign the transfer package. The decision to open the gateway will be made at the council.
Quest main 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Player, so there are others somewhere, and someone is keeping score.
Quest main 01: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll check what exactly you've opened and who's receiving the data. Then, we'll continue.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सिस्टमquest_main_01.start.choice.defiance.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Don't call it initialization. I'm not a device. Tell me the task and I'll decide what to do with it.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_01.start.choice.people.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If it helps Emily and me, I'll do it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My head is buzzing, like someone switched on another person's memory. Fine, I'll figure it out.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_01.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A terminal in the middle of a dead district. Someone really wants me to reach it.
Quest main 02: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_02.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It affects mine. If this isn't a disease, then all this time we've been asking the wrong questions.
Quest main 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_02.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll take the samples, but I won't let altered people be treated as nameless raw material for the sake of our power.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_02.start.choice.science.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You'll get the samples. If you're leading players toward development, I need to understand your rules from the inside.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सिस्टमquest_main_02.start.choice.skeptic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, tell me why you need these samples. As long as you stay silent, the data and the decision stay under our control.
Quest main 03: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_03.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The signal in the park can wait till morning. Doors and weapons first, or there'll be no one left to listen.
Quest main 03: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_03.start.choice.people.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Emily and I need proper light. Emergency power isn't enough.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_03.start.choice.protocol.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Generator, Line, Reserve. Stabilization first, then any new tasks of yours.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_03.start.choice.skeptic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll build the reserve, but if you know the grid layout so precisely, you know more about the bunker than you're saying.
Quest main 04: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_04.step_05.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You can barely stand. Let me take you somewhere safe. You can lie down for a while.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_04.step_05.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You can thank me later. Get ready. We're heading to the bunker.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_04.step_05.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Extra hands will come in handy. Come on, there's room in the bunker.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_04.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hi, I'm Nathan. I caught your signal. Didn't think anyone was still holding out in this park.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_04.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there are living people out there, we have no right to walk past. If it's a trap, I'll be the first to find out.
Quest main 05: End (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_05.end.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Thanks for looking out for me. I won't let my guard down. You've got enough of other people's wounds as it is.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_05.end.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Oh, come on. After today, nothing scares us anymore.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_05.end.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll relax when things stop trying to eat us, so not any time soon.
Quest main 05: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_05.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. Workshop first, then the hardware. Arguing with a medic never ends well.
Quest main 06: End (3)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_06.end.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The leader has fallen. If the rest want to repeat his mistake, let them come.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_06.end.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The leader is dead. Now we finish off whoever decides to take his place.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_06.end.choice.open.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I don't like that it all ended in a killing, but he left us no other way out.
Quest main 06: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_06.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. Lock the entrance and keep the line open. I'll be back when it's quiet out there.
Quest main 07: End (5)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.choice.survivors.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Survivors first. If we're too late, there'll be nothing left to fix.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.choice.system.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Bandits first. If they hit the bunker, there'll be no one left to save.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file What a run! A couple of pulses on the street is one thing. These psi abilities at full strength are another. You can't call it anything but magic.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Almost nothing. It only said we can't survive without these abilities. Useful, of course, but…
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.07.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No. It told me to try the abilities out for real. I did. That's it.
Quest main 07: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First we check how it works, without risk. Then we decide how much we can rely on it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.start.choice.open.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Honestly, these gifts shake me up no less than they do you, but we won't be alone. We'll figure it out together.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Emotions later. It's just a new tool. We'll learn to use it. That's all.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Just no fanaticism. I don't want to learn the cost of a mistake the hard way.
Quest main 08a: Choice (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_08a.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm taking the log. There's nothing more to decide here. The camp is cleared and the bunker needs the records.
Quest main 08a: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सिस्टमquest_main_08a.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A reward doesn't wash away the filth, but empty hands don't save anyone either.
Quest main 08a: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_08a.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Sounds like robbery and nice rapping. Fine, if it keeps the bunker afloat.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सिस्टमquest_main_08a.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A reward doesn't change the fact that someone will pay for it. The question is, who?
Quest main 08b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_08b.route.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Don't blame yourself for the choice. We take the detour. We'll get out alive and bring them out too.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_08b.route.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Detour. Less risk. Right now, that matters more than a couple of extra minutes.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_08b.route.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Simple math. If there are living people there, minutes are worth more than the risk. We go straight, and no panic.
Quest main 08b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_08b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yes, we didn't save anyone, and I won't call it a victory. We'll write everything down honestly and check the next signal faster.
Quest main 08b: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_08b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Take a med kit and a flashlight. Let's go. But keep your head. If it's bait, we leave it once.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_08b.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let's go quietly. We find a trail. We grab onto it and don't let go.
Quest main 09a: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सिस्टमquest_main_09a.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Finally, not flying blind, now we can make a plan instead of a prayer.
Quest main 09a: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_09a.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Escape route first, then the drive. The data is useless if I don't bring it back.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_09a.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll intercept the courier and take the drive. The less time he has, the less blood tomorrow.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_09a.start.choice.question.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll take the data, but then you'll explain how you know his route before we do.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_09a.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The courier doesn't know he's being hunted. As long as that holds, the advantage is mine.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_09a.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So the courier himself is gone. I'm copying the roots and getting ready to meet whoever came for them.
Quest main 09b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_09b.route.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If something goes wrong, that's on me, not you. We go through the yards. It's quieter.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_09b.route.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Through the courtyards, less noise, less chance of running into trouble.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_09b.route.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No time for fears. We go where it's faster. The less we fuss, the safer we'll be.
Quest main 09b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_09b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then, we still have a chance to meet them, and the storage fractal will serve the bunker. We didn't come for nothing.
Quest main 09b: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_09b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll make it. We go quietly. Look first, then act. If anyone hears us too early, we pull back at once.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_09b.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Stay close, we'll look around and decide whether it's worth going deeper.
Quest main 10: End (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_10.after_defense.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Are you okay yourself? Looks like you got hit.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_10.after_defense.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Already Reloaded. Warm welcome. I'll give them that.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_10.after_defense.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file How many of them are left out there? We need to know how long we can last.
Quest main 10: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_10.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file On my way, give me a sector and keep the line open in case they come from the flank.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Afraid→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_10.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file They're heading for the stabilizer. If the gates don't hold, we hold the ground in front of the installation.
Quest main 11: Choice (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_11.route.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Only the detour. Walking into the line of fire is pure recklessness.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_11.route.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Straight through, we'll slip past fast before they come to their senses.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_11.route.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Detour. I don't need any extra lead in my head today.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_11.intro.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, we're holding a bunker in the old town. Are you here alone?
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_11.intro.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need defense blueprints and metal, and people who aren't afraid to walk into fire.
Quest main 11: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_11.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A firefighter who cracks jokes under fire. All right, Liam, welcome to the bunker.
Quest main 11: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_11.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Fine. I'll look around and drag back everything that'll help us hold out.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_11.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. In quietly, out quietly. I'm not planning to play the hero.
Quest main 12: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_12.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Better metal rattling than bones. Let's keep going.
Quest main 12: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_12.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If part of the sector has to be written off for the sake of the main entrance, we write it off. The bunker matters, not every meter.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_12.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We break the perimeter into nodes. Turrets, barricades, retreat. No gaps and no heroics.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_12.start.choice.shield.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We set up defenses for people, not for a report. Let everyone inside have one more minute of life.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_12.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file In order it is, I'm starting with the barricades. Without them, the turrets won't last long.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_12.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Will do. Nothing fancy. Just working.
Quest main 13: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_13.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The park won't become a graveyard today, but tomorrow, they'll come looking for a new leader.
Quest main 13: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_13.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there are living people in the park, I won't turn them into bait for the sake of a clean hunt.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_13.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll scout the route and the retreat. The leader is dangerous, but a blind rush will feed the whole pack.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_13.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the Guardian out with the first strike. Without its leader, the pack will turn back into noise.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_13.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll do it. We'll get people out of harm's way and finish that thing before it gets a taste for it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_13.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. Aim for the head. Fast. Before the pack gathers.
Quest main 14: End (6)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.choice.survivors.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go to the laboratories. If there's a trace of the system there, I want to see it with my own eyes instead of waiting for the terminal's mercy.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_14.choice.system.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We install the antennas. If the task has a timer, we close it first, and we'll beat the answers about the system out of it later.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_14.end.natalie_04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then stay on the line, Natalie. If we go down there, we'll need what you know.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.07.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There is. It just came in. And this time with a timer.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_14.end.08.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The system wants us to install some antennas for it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.end.23.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file What do you mean?
Quest main 14: Start (6)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We keep the deal small. Check the channel, the price, the return trail. No trust on credit.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.start.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the terminal starts bargaining for my soul, tell me in advance. At least I'll pick nice packaging.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.start.choice.trust.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If they're willing to talk, let's try to trust them. Someone has to be the first to stop waiting for a blow.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Deal. We go carefully. Find the camp, wake up the terminal, and see who comes to the signal.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I won't. Talk little, watch a lot, like you taught me.
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.meeting.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll fix the terminal and take you both to our bunker. Stay close.
Quest main 15b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_15b.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll take the short route. If there's a trap, I'll turn around instead of proving to a wall that I'm more stubborn.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_15b.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the fast route gives more data, the risk is justified, without facts or losing people blindly anyway.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_15b.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go carefully. Better less data than one more loss. We already have too many empty spots on the list of the living.
Quest main 15b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_15b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file They do, yes, but now we know where to look and whom to ask when the time comes.
Quest main 15b: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_15b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hear you, but if you're right, then someone was pulling the strings even before the end of the world, and that won't let me breathe.
Quest main 16a: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_16a.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll set up the antennas along the shortest route. If the area is boiling, we need to finish faster.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_16a.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I choose the points with the best coverage. The risk is higher, but the link won't fall apart at the worst moment later.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_16a.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go quieter and farther, better slower than leaving a trail of blood to every point.
Quest main 16a: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_16a.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We have a link. Now I'd like to understand who's listening along with us.
Quest main 16a: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_16a.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. Just remember, if we make a mistake, the living will pay for it, not your numbers.
Quest main 16b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_16b.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we mark the retreat and a clear sector. Then, we strike when it has no corner left to lunge from.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_16b.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We press briefly. You hold the flank. I take the creature on myself. No unnecessary heroics.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_16b.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the detour. We'll lose time, but we'll all come back. You included.
Quest main 16b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_16b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I don't need praise. I need someone to wake up alive tomorrow.
Quest main 16b: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_16b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hear you. We keep our distance and don't jump into its jaws for the sake of heroics.
Quest main 17: Cutscene (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Surprised→प्रेतquest_main_17.observer.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nora?
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→प्रेतquest_main_17.observer.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Where is she? If you know, tell me.
Quest main 17: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_17.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file She thinks like me, too closely for coincidence. Until I understand whether she's an ally or a mirror, we keep the channel under control.
Quest main 17: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_17.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll check the approaches and keep the retreat open. If she's calling us into the dark, I'm not going there with my eyes closed.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_17.start.choice.facts.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Data first. The place, the traces, who else heard the signal? We go to Phoenix only when the facts add up.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_17.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If Phoenix is useful, we'll get routes out of her. If not, we won't pay with people for riddles.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_17.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Phoenix, I don't know why, but that name tightens my throat. Let's go.
Quest main 18: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Afraid→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_18.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Noted. We gather the wounded and patch the holes while we still have anyone left to patch them.
Quest main 18: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_18.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we pull out the wounded and the civilians. The route isn't worth those who are still breathing.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_18.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We keep the pace, but don't walk into a trap. Quieter, but without unnecessary funerals.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_18.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We bring the route back under control. Fast, hard, no unnecessary talk.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_18.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. Keep in touch. As soon as it gets quieter, I'll give the signal.
Quest main 18: Step (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_18.oliver_meet.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A mechanic then, who are you and where to now?
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_18.oliver_meet.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We've got a bunker, and its generators are running on a prayer. Help us with them, and there's a place for you.
Quest main 19: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_19.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then strip everything that survived, and keep a cool head, machines die too.
Quest main 19: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_19.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go by protocol. Lure it out, keep our distance, watch for overheating. We prepare the retreat in advance.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_19.start.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Since it's yours, you know it's weak spots. I'll face it in the open. Let's see what your build is worth.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_19.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We lure it out and take it down. No legends, just results and parts for the next version.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_19.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Deal. But if your mech turns out tougher than you remember, we pull back. The parts can wait.
Quest main 20: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I go in, find the office, get out. No extra laps.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there's tech or access cards, I'll take them too. Information matters, but resources are just as important right now.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the intel first. If there's data on survivors, it matters more than trophies.
Quest main 20: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then, these papers were worth the risk. We'll go through them. And next time, we won't go in blind.
Quest main 20: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If they have maps and schedules, sooner or later, they'll find the bunker.
Quest main 20: Step (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.camp_entrance.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The camp is close. Lots of fires. The patrols change on a schedule. Doesn't look like a random gang.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.observation.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file 30 seconds of quiet, and I've already got a list of entrances, storerooms, and places where they hide documents.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Surprised→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_20.office.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Found their office. Crates of access cards, mechanical parts, route records.
Quest main 21: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_21.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file All right, Natalie, just stay behind me, and if I say back, you leave without arguing.
Quest main 21: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_21.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll see it with our own eyes, but keep our distance and our retreat. Live bait is still bait.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_21.start.choice.facts.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go for data. Traces, background radiation, the zone's behavior. If it's a chance, we'll prove it with facts, not hope.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_21.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the zone gives us a resource or a route, we'll take it. If not, we won't feed it our curiosity.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_21.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Alright, if it's a trap, better it's snaps shut on me than on those sleeping behind the bunker door.
Quest main 22: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_22.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So it wasn't chaos. It was a test of our defenses. By the next strike, we'll meet them on our own terms.
Quest main 22: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_22.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The wounded will get out without me. I'm pressing the headquarters now, before they burn the orders.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_22.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We block the retreat and don't stretch the line. We take the headquarters fast and the orders intact.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_22.start.choice.shield.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Liam, get the people to cover. I'll block the retreat and follow the trail once the sector is clear.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_22.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. We go to the suburb, find their escape route, and take the headquarters before the trail goes cold.
Quest main 23: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_23.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We cut the power with an emergency shutdown. If an alarm goes off, we'll deal with it after the passage opens.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_23.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We shut it down by the book. You call out the steps. I carry them out and hold the passage.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_23.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go with the safe sequence. It'll take more time, but we won't wake up the whole sector.
Quest main 23: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_23.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then let's hold on to that air and not waste it on foolishness.
Quest main 23: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_23.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Keep me on the line. If something starts burning, tell me right away.
Quest main 24: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_24.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Weapon down. Tell me who you are and why the camp was hunting you.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_24.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file As long as you're useful, we talk. Make a move, and the conversation's over.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_24.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I came to check the signal, don't shoot, and I won't either.
Quest main 24: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_24.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You'll earn your place. Start with the truth and with a safe route to the port.
Quest main 24: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_24.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The signal might be a trap. We'll check the camp, but we won't reveal the way to the bunker.
Quest main 25: End (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_25.choice.survivors.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We pull the data. If the system only shows the truth that suits it, it's time to look under the interface.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_25.choice.system.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We restore the terminals without interfering. Until we understand its limits, we don't provoke something stronger than us.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_main_25.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Will you come with us, David? The bunker is cramped and noisy, but the walls hold.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_main_25.end.11.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Often enough that I've stopped calling it a coincidence. It gives us tools, but only explains the conditions.
Quest main 25: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_25.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First the guard post, then the signal source. If there's a survivor there, we bring him out through the same corridor.
Quest main 26a: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_26a.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I go straight ahead. The terminals matter more than perfect silence.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_26a.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll bring up the nodes that give the most network. If part of the route is dirty, we'll do without pretty solutions.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_26a.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm going through cover. Slower, but without extra noise.
Quest main 26a: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_26a.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good. Now the main thing is that this network doesn't become a cage.
Quest main 26a: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_26a.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hear you. If the network collapses again, people will start dying faster. I'll take care of it.
Quest main 26b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_26b.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We hit the hotspot with a short run. In, pull the data, out. No unnecessary heroics.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_26b.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go where there's more data. If we want to understand the system, we'll have to pay with risk.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_26b.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go where the chance of coming back is higher. Facts aren't worth a life.
Quest main 26b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_26b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then, sooner or later, we're going there. Only now, we go with a map. Not by invitation.
Quest main 26b: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_26b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First we get to the node and assess the defenses. We'll make the decision before the first hack, not after it's too late.
Quest main 27a: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_27a.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take a short route, check the console, and leave. Even in silence, we keep the escape route open.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_27a.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file 15 minutes without new attacks is a rare resource. We take the cash and everything useful along the way.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_27a.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll use the window, but your help doesn't make us your subordinates.
Quest main 27a: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Contempt→सिस्टमquest_main_27a.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A useful gift, but what I'll remember isn't the crystals, it's that you can silence an entire location with a single decision.
Quest main 27a: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_27a.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file 15 minutes of quiet and a cash deep in the metro. Too generous for a random gift. We'll use the window, but keep our eyes open.
Quest main 27b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_27b.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the nearest route, but work against the timer. If the zone stirs, straight back.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_27b.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need samples, not a quiet stroll. We pick the place where the chance of results is higher.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_27b.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the far route. Samples can be gathered tomorrow. People can't.
Quest main 27b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_27b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Someone's synchronizing clocks. Then we find out what they're preparing for before it happens.
Quest main 27b: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_27b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. We go fast and smart. If it's a trap, we grab a piece of the truth and leave.
Quest main 28: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_main_28.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file David, without you, the beacon would have stayed silent. Thanks.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_main_28.end.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's a place, and figure out that tune on the beacon frequency.
Quest main 28: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_28.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If I have to leave part of the field uncovered to get the lights on, I will. What matters is beating the dark.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_28.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Substation, Beacon, Gates. In order, no detours.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_28.start.choice.shield.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We work so that not a single creature reaches the bunker. Everything else can wait.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_28.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file 30 minutes. Then we talk on the move.
Quest main 28: Step (2)
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_main_28.beacon.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Do it. Just be quick. The light won't last.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_main_28.beacon.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Record it. Right now, I need those gates.
Quest main 29: End (1)

Quest main 29: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_29.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there are still living people inside, I won't turn the supermarket into a meat grinder for a clean report.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_29.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we cut down the noise around it. The leader is dangerous, but an exposed back is more dangerous.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_29.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take out the leader and leave. The shorter the fight, the less chance the pack has to gather.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_29.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Deal. We go in quietly and finish fast.
Quest main 30: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_30.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the talker, but I'm the one leading him. If he lies about the spot, he'll be the first to find out.
  • नेथन कोल→जैकब मार्शquest_main_30.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the talker. The more he says, the more leads we'll pull out, even if half of it is garbage.
  • नेथन कोल→जैकब मार्शquest_main_30.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the quiet one. Fewer words, better chances of coming back.
Quest main 30: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→जैकब मार्शquest_main_30.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then we take the next step by coordinates, not by nerves.
Quest main 30: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल→जैकब मार्शquest_main_30.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. I'll mark the spot and see who's guarding it.
Quest main 31: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_31.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file But now it's clear. They're ready to burn everything around just to drive us out. So, it'll get dirtier from here.
Quest main 31: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_31.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go quietly. Timers and wires first. Everything else later. Panic kills faster than an explosion.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→जैकब मार्शquest_main_31.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll find the depot and break the chain before they realize there are no more charges.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_31.start.choice.shield.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll mark where the blast wave will go. If there are living people nearby, we get them out before any heroics.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→जैकब मार्शquest_main_31.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Understood. I'll find the depot and blow it myself, so the blast stays in their camp instead of reaching the city.
Quest main 32: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→इंडिया रायनquest_main_32.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Places aren't earned with promises, but you took a risk to be heard. Let's go.
Quest main 32: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_32.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll rule out bait. I'll only bring someone we can trust to the bunker.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_32.start.choice.protect.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there's a person there, I'll get them out. I'll check the signal on the way.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सिस्टमquest_main_32.start.choice.skeptic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If this is your trap, the signal will die along with the transmitter.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_32.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm going to the hangar. Source first, then the decision.
Quest main 33: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_33.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We collect the trophy and leave. People need this corridor and one more night without nightmares.
Quest main 33: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_33.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If people are stuck there, I won't seal the sector with them inside for the sake of a pretty sweep.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_33.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Entry point and retreat first. If the target is smart, it's expecting us to run toward the noise.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_33.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the target down fast and clean. The less time it has for the pack, the more people will see the morning.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_33.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Give me the point and landmarks. The less noise, the better the chances of coming back.
Quest main 34: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_34.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file He can stay, but I want to know who locked him in there and why.
Quest main 34: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_34.start.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the mineral holds the grid, I'll go deeper and take more. There may not be a second chance.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_34.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Give me the location and the signs of the mineral. I'll find a sample, carry it out, and come back before the grid sags.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_34.start.choice.protocol.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the mineral by the protocol. Measurement, container, background check. You don't save the grid with dirty hands.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_34.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. I'll get the mineral and won't let the power grid die because of one pretty theory.
Quest main 35: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_35.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll check the ammo and head back. The next run has to go through without a funeral.
Quest main 35: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_35.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If we have to burn part of the root, we'll burn it. Supplies matter more than neatly preserving the area.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_35.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We work by the tracks. Bait, distance, control of the retreat. No hunting on emotion.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_35.start.choice.shield.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The route is needed by living people, not by a warehouse on paper. We take out karkan and open the road without unnecessary losses.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_35.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. Karkin knows these roots better than we do, so we hit him where he doesn't expect us.
Quest main 36: End (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.choice.survivors.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we check the coordinates with Natalie. The decision on the route stays with people.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.choice.system.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We use the system's coordinates and priorities. First, we eliminate its targets.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Your project survived. Now make sure it saves the bunker instead of becoming one more legend about our stupidity.
Quest main 36: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.start.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the MEC 3.9 can take a hit, let it prove it for real. The sector needs more than a museum piece.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll test the machine in battle and get the sector out from under attack. No legends, just a working result.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.start.choice.protocol.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We keep the machine on protocol. Distance, overheating, emergency cutoff. No glory at the cost of the circuit.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_36.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. We don't play heroes. I check the machine, cover the sector, and get out alive.
Quest main 37a: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_37a.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I check the route and lure the targets out one at a time. Urgency is no reason to jump into a meat grinder.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_37a.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hit the targets that get in the way of the assault the most. The rest can wait.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_37a.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Direct contact. Only the targets in the chain. We leave the rest alone, but we open the road to the heart.
Quest main 37a: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_37a.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go back quietly. The system heart will wait exactly as long as it takes not to lead danger behind us.
Quest main 37a: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_main_37a.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I see the chain. I'll walk it my way.
Quest main 37b: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_37b.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the route where the coordinates are more precise. If the price is higher, then later we'll be faster and make fewer mistakes.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_37b.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We follow the survivor's path. If the heart can be found without breaking people along the way, we take that chance.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_37b.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the fast way and don't argue on the move. If I'm wrong, it's on me.
Quest main 37b: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_37b.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then, enough counting. Time to go.
Quest main 37b: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_37b.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm keeping the channel open. If the route starts lying, tell me before we enter it.

Quest main 38: Start (4)

Quest main 39: Start (4)

  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_39.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we watch the rhythm of its attacks and the exits. If it's a battle of attrition, whoever breathes longer wins.

  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_40.operation.release.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nora, the gateway is open. I'm transferring the core into the interworld network.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_main_40.operation.stay.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nora, Earth is free. We're transferring your only core into the body you agreed to.

Quest main park greenhouse: Start (1)

Quest personal david 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_personal_david_02.start.choice.mirror.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we mirror the node into a closed circuit. The answers shouldn't die from a single command by someone else.

Quest personal david 03: End (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_personal_david_03.start.choice.secure.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We lock the archive in an isolated circuit and keep the checksums. Let the enemy think we noticed nothing.

Quest personal india 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→इंडिया रायनquest_personal_india_02.start.choice.abort.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file At the first discrepancy in the instruments, we cancel the flight. A plane can be fixed again. A pilot can't.

Quest personal india 03: Start (3)

Quest personal liam 01: Start (3)

Quest personal liam 02: End (1)

Quest personal liam 02: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_personal_liam_02.start.choice.civilians.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll check whether people were left behind in one of the versions of the event. The recording may be impossible, but the missing people are real.

Quest personal liam 03: Start (3)

Quest personal liang 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liang_01.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go by the protocol. Samples, control point, double labeling. No faith, only data.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liang_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I won't drag people into caustic dust for the sake of a theory. First, we check the filter and the escape route.

  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liang_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We follow the protocol. Samples, a control point, double labeling. We'll bring the data, and we won't leave anyone behind.
Quest personal liang 02: End (1)

Quest personal liang 02: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liang_02.start.choice.people.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First I'll check that the dust isn't poisoning the group. The flasks matter, but living lungs matter more.

Quest personal liang 03: End (1)

Quest personal liang 03: Start (4)

Quest personal liu 02: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liu_02.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So it knows my habits, but doesn't possess the rule by which I can change myself. That's no longer just a calculation error.
Quest personal liu 02: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liu_02.start.choice.calm.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll repeat the expected sequence and let the model grow confident in its forecast. Then, I'll change one decision.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liu_02.start.choice.guard.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll give up a profitable move for a person the model considers expendable. Let's see whether it can predict a principle, not a habit.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liu_02.start.choice.pressure.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file In the middle of the simulation, I'll choose an action with no ready-made benefit. Let the model try to explain what wasn't in its rules.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liu_02.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Run the model. First, I'll give it a familiar rhythm. Then, I'll make a choice it didn't account for.
Quest personal liu 03: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_personal_liu_03.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then we haven't found an answer, but the boundary of someone else's knowledge. That's enough to take the next step without pretending we've understood everything.
Quest personal liu 03: Start (4)

Quest personal marcos 01: Start (3)

Quest personal marcos 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_personal_marcos_02.start.choice.control.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We don't chase a pretty attack. We cut off the edge of the wave and keep the retreat open.

Quest personal marcos 03: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_personal_marcos_03.start.choice.bait.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll lure it toward me. If the pack lunges after me, the group will get a clean shot.

Quest personal maya 01: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→माया चेनquest_personal_maya_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the instruments. People need more than rations, or the bunker will become a grave with ventilation.

Quest personal maya 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_personal_maya_02.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll set aside a corner for silence. If people can't breathe inside, the walls won't save us.

Quest personal maya 03: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_personal_maya_03.start.choice.heart.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You keep the people together, I'll open the way. The lists matter more than revenge. The living need to be warned.
