Quest personal nataly 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll tell you in order, just let's separate what I saw from what we're assuming.
Quest personal nataly 01: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We follow the data, not guesses. Recon first, then any conclusions.
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_01.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take only what gives the bunker an advantage right away. The rest waits for a better window.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_01.start.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I don't want to leave the system the right to decide what we get to know. I'll check what survived there.
Quest personal nataly 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_02.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the archive starts burning time, we take only what will help the bunker now.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_02.start.choice.stealth.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the copies quietly and leave before the alarm. The truth is only useful if we deliver it alive.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_02.start.choice.truth.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the full package. If the system is hiding something, that's exactly what we need to read.
Quest personal nataly 03: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_03.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So someone chose in advance what to leave without power. We'll make our decision with that fact in mind.
Quest personal nataly 03: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_03.start.choice.burden.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the truth hits the team, I'll take the first blow myself. We don't hide it, but we don't throw it in people's faces either.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_03.start.choice.calm.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First we stabilize the people, then we announce the conclusions. Panic will ruin even the right decision.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nataly_03.start.choice.facts.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll look myself and report without filters. We'll decide on facts, not on fear.
Quest personal nathan 00: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_personal_nathan_00.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My daughter, I saw her on the road right before the crash, red hair, the way she walks.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_personal_nathan_00.start.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Wait, it couldn't have been her.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_personal_nathan_00.start.06.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Because Nora died, long ago, before all of this. I sat with her in the hospital until the last day. And on the road, after the impact, my head filled in what I wanted to see.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_personal_nathan_00.start.08.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Don't tell the others. And let's not talk about her anymore. I need to work.
Quest personal nathan 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सिस्टमquest_personal_nathan_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Enough silence. It'll hurt more from here on. Let's go.
Quest personal nathan 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_personal_nathan_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I copy the data into a closed circuit. I won't hand my fears over to the system.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_personal_nathan_01.start.choice.confront.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm going to the end. If the past wants to speak with the system's voice, I'll still hear it out.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_personal_nathan_01.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take only confirmed marks. We need the truth, but not at the cost of a broken team.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_personal_nathan_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The protocol won't lead me blindly, but I'm not running from the truth anymore either.
Quest personal nathan 02: End (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.end.confess_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It's my project. Phoenix. When Nora was dying, I uploaded her imprint into it.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Give me a minute. Then we'll gather the others and decide what's next.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.end.confess_03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Not to bring her back. So there'd be someone to talk to once she was gone. I thought it hadn't worked. When the Phoenix signal came, I told Natalie I didn't know why that name made my throat tighten. I knew.
Quest personal nathan 02: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we secure the channel and copy the files. I won't let the system play on my memory.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.start.choice.team.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the data starts breaking the ranks, we cut access. My story isn't more important than the team's safety.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.start.choice.truth.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If my truth is there, I have to see it myself. No filters and no pretty versions.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_personal_nathan_02.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file This time, the past won't pass me by as someone else's order.
Quest personal nathan 02: Step (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Surprised→Mob boss apexquest_personal_nathan_02.step.apex_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You're guarding my servers? Who put you here?
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→Mob boss apexquest_personal_nathan_02.step.apex_04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So she was waiting for me here before she ever called.
Quest personal nathan 03: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nathan_03.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, I'll tell you. You know how to separate facts from fear. Help me find the words for the others.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nathan_03.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we say, what will help keep order? We'll give the full truth when the team can take it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nathan_03.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then I'll tell the truth myself. I won't hide behind the protocol or hand it to the team as an order.
Quest personal nathan 03: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nathan_03.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Done. Now it's not just my protocol. It's our choice, and I won't hide behind silence.
Quest personal nathan 03: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_personal_nathan_03.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Alright, first I'll sort it out myself, then I'll tell them.
Quest personal nora 00: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_personal_nora_00.start.choice.cut.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I won't talk to a ghost. The channel is closed.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_personal_nora_00.start.choice.doubt.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You speak with her voice, but I don't know who you are.
  • नेथन कोल→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_personal_nora_00.start.choice.hope.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm here. I can hear you.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Afraid→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_personal_nora_00.start.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No, this can't be.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→फ़ीनिक्स Xquest_personal_nora_00.start.05.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nora died. I was there.
Quest personal oliver 01: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the stability profile. Less power, but no overheating and no sudden darkness.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_01.start.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the boosted profile. If the circuit can handle the maximum now, the bunker will get a power reserve.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the balanced profile. Standard power, standard protection, no experiments.
Quest personal oliver 02: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_02.start.choice.people.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We set a load limit and an emergency reserve. We'll keep the scheme, but we won't burn out the only person who understands it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_02.start.choice.protocol.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Diagnostics first, then the boost. Let the circuit switch on once and not burn up along with our hopes.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_02.start.choice.speed.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We assemble a working bypass now. A perfect circuit won't save us if the lights go out before launch.
Quest personal oliver 03: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_03.start.choice.launch.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We launch the backup circuit and hold the tower. Without light, we'll be shooting at shadows again.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_03.start.choice.limit.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We don't push the circuit to death, better less power than another darkness after overheating.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_personal_oliver_03.start.choice.protect.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Launch only with a safety net. I cover the circuit. You hold the emergency exit. No heroics on the tower.
Quest personal sera 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So the people we brought out will breathe tonight. Discipline without mercy would just be fear.
Quest personal sera 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I go first. If you get scared, say so right away. Let's not play Iron Man.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_01.start.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We get people out and don't lie to ourselves about the cost. If someone doesn't make it, that's on us too.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_01.start.choice.reckless.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we block the corridor and wait for a window. If the sector breaks loose, we pull back, even if it hurts.
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. We get the people out and seal the sector.
Quest personal sera 02: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_02.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file People will breathe out before dawn, and you check the shifts. Order holds not on fear, but on repetition.
Quest personal sera 02: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_02.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm scared too. That's why we keep our voices steady and don't let fear speak for us.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_02.start.choice.front.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go out to the line first. Let them see not promises, but a back they can stand behind.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_02.start.choice.honesty.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We can tell people it will be hard. False confidence breaks louder than a wall.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_02.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Knight will see our formation, not our fear.
Quest personal sera 03: Choice (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_03.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We tell the truth straight. Whoever stays by our side after that will stay for real.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_03.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We reveal only what will help people survive. The rest shouldn't break the team before the fight.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_03.choice.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll tell the truth and won't hide behind an order. If questions remain afterwards, I'll answer them myself.
Quest personal sera 03: Cutscene (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_03.observer.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let her go.
Quest personal sera 03: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_03.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then we hold our course and answer for the consequences.
Quest personal sera 03: Start (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_personal_sera_03.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll hear you out to the end, and I won't make the choice out of fear.
Quest side mvp 01 kill zombies: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_01_kill_zombies.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The passage is clear. We need to get the groups out before they come back.
Quest side mvp 01 kill zombies: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_01_kill_zombies.start.choice.fast.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll clear it fast. Before the pack gathers more tightly, the corridor can be opened with little blood.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_01_kill_zombies.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. I'll take down the pack and open a safe corridor for people.
Quest side mvp 02 collect resources: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_02_collect_resources.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The supplies are in the bunker. That'll give us one more day.
Quest side mvp 02 collect resources: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_02_collect_resources.start.choice.priority.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Scrap metal first. Without it, repairs stall. I'll leave anything extra if it slows the retreat.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_02_collect_resources.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Alright, I'll gather everything that can still be carried and be back before dark.
Quest side mvp 03 defense waves: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_03_defense_waves.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We fought them off. People need to breathe, and the next shift needs to get ready.
Quest side mvp 03 defense waves: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_03_defense_waves.start.choice.line.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hold the line and don't chase stragglers. The line matters more than pretty statistics.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_03_defense_waves.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. We hold the line and don't let them near the shelter.
Quest side mvp 04 reach level: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_04_reach_level.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good, now we're not a panicking crowd, but a team.
Quest side mvp 04 reach level: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_04_reach_level.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We train formation and basic reactions. The team should move like a team.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_04_reach_level.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Deal. We'll run the drills and get people back in shape.
Quest side mvp 05 destroy object: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_05_destroy_object.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The node is dust. The bunker should get on the air while the window is open.
Quest side mvp 05 destroy object: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_05_destroy_object.start.choice.silent.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll approach quietly and take the note out without noise. The best sabotage is the one noticed late.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_05_destroy_object.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Enough putting up with this jammer. I'm going to break the node before it breaks us.
Quest side mvp 06 kill boss: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_06_kill_boss.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file One alpha down, but a new one will take its place soon, so let's not slow down.
Quest side mvp 06 kill boss: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_06_kill_boss.start.choice.burst.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I take the target down fast. The shorter the fight, the less chance it has to call the pack.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_06_kill_boss.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. First I'll find Karkan, then choose a place for the fight where his pack won't pin us against the water.
Quest side mvp 07 signal relay: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_07_signal_relay.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The link is holding. We need to reach our people before the airwaves choke.
Quest side mvp 07 signal relay: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_07_signal_relay.start.choice.priority.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The highest node first. If it comes back to life, the rest will be easier to find.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_07_signal_relay.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. If we restore communications, people will have a chance to call for help again.
Quest side mvp 08 medicine run: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_08_medicine_run.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Medkits are here. For the first time in a long while, we're healing, not just counting losses.
Quest side mvp 08 medicine run: Start (2)
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_08_medicine_run.start.choice.kits.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First aid kits and supplies first. Anything that doesn't save lives can wait for the next raid.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_side_mvp_08_medicine_run.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. I'm going to the supermarket. I'll check the pharmacy sections and come back with what will keep people on their feet.
Quest side mvp 09a civilians first: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good. Now, we hold out this night. And tomorrow, we'll have to look in the eyes of those who go out with almost no ammo.
Quest side mvp 09a civilians first: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Civilians First If the aid station is empty, we've already lost the very reason we're holding up the walls.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the medicine, but keep an escape route and a reserve for the shooters. Panic won't help us either.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If these drugs get people back in action faster, we take them. Compassion has to work too.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I hear you. Then we go for the medicine. But I know the price. On the next outing, our shooters will be counting every round.
Quest side mvp 09b defense first: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yes, we held the walls, but someone paid for it with pain inside them. Decisions like that don't let go.
Quest side mvp 09b defense first: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll choose defense, but don't call those left without medicine an acceptable loss.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the ammo, but we don't strip everything bare. The aid station needs a chance too. We need order, not a new crack in the team.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We're holding the perimeter. If the walls collapse, the aid station will simply become another room for corpses.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_09b_defense_first.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. We'll take the ammo and hold the line. But that means the aid station will have to choose who gets treated first again.
Quest side mvp 10a refugee convoy: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good, but now the perimeter is thinner. No kind choice comes without a debt.
Quest side mvp 10a refugee convoy: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We lead the column. If we stop opening doors to the living, the bunker becomes just a concrete grave.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We get them out, but split the route into groups. One mistake, and we lead the waves straight to the gates.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there are working hands and knowledge among them, the risk will pay off. We get them out, but count the load on the bunker.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Alright, we lead the people. But after this, the defenses will sag, and everyone will have to get through the night on edge.
Quest side mvp 10b power grid: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yes, we chose the survival of the majority, but that doesn't make the choice clean. It just makes it ours.
Quest side mvp 10b power grid: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll switch on the grid, but don't pretend the people by the road have become less alive than the people behind the wall.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We power the defenses, but leave a group watching the column. Total blindness there will hit us too.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We bring the grid up. Without light, doors and turrets, we're not a shelter, we're a feeding trough.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_10b_power_grid.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then I'll bring the substations back up, and remember, this choice will come back to us.
Quest side mvp 11a prisoner exchange: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yes, but it's not over. We bought lives now, and a debt for later.
Quest side mvp 11a prisoner exchange: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We make the exchange. Living people matter more than a pretty victory over someone already in our hands.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll exchange, but with markers, surveillance, and a backup retreat. Mercy without insurance quickly becomes a trap.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If one prisoner buys us several living people today, that's a deal worth taking.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file All right, we make the exchange, but I'll remember his face. Next time, he may come back with fire.
Quest side mvp 11b zero mercy: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yes, we held the walls, but part of us stayed on the other side of those walls.
Quest side mvp 11b zero mercy: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I won't give up our people, but I don't want to build safety on something we'll later have to hide from the children.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll answer with force, but without a showcase slaughter. Fear only works as long as we haven't become worse than the threat.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We hit hard and fast. If they hunt our people, let them be afraid to come near the doors.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_11b_zero_mercy.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Decided. We go hard. Just don't try to call it an easy decision.
Quest side mvp 12a school evac: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Today, we chose life. Tomorrow, we'll pay for that choice with time and blood.
Quest side mvp 12a school evac: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go for the children. If we start treating them as a secondary objective, the bunker has already lost.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We get them out in small groups and clear the corridor in advance. The rescue mustn't turn into a stampede.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If we get the children out, the adults in the bunker will believe again that all this isn't for nothing. That's a resource, too.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let's go. The Armory will survive a Knight at Halfguard. The children won't.
Quest side mvp 12b armory guard: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The choice was dirty, and now we have to live with it.
Quest side mvp 12b armory guard: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll lock down the depot, but don't call the school sentimentality. There are people there, not a lying in a report.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We reinforce the depot, but don't burn through all the reserves. Weapons matter, but an empty flank won't save them.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We lock down the armory. Without weapons, the next assault will end not in an argument, but in a list of the dead.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_12b_armory_guard.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Decided. We lock down the depot and hold the perimeter. We're not crossing the school out. It'll just have to wait.
Quest side mvp 13a truth archive: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then we hold our course. Today is hard, but tomorrow, at least we'll know whom to look for.
Quest side mvp 13a truth archive: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→डेविड किमquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll get the records, but I don't want hungry people to feel forgotten because of them.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→डेविड किमquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm going for the logs. If they show who directed the raids, we have no right to look away.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need the truth, not for an argument. If we don't keep a record of who profited from those first hours and how, we'll be deceived again.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_side_mvp_13a_truth_archive.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Alright, I'm going for the logs. Truth is a resource, too. You just can't see it in the rations.
Quest side mvp 13b food priority: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We chose life today. That means tomorrow, we'll have a chance to hold them accountable for everything.
Quest side mvp 13b food priority: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We take the food, but leave markers for the archive. If the trail goes completely cold, we'll regret it later.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Food first. A hungry team doesn't hold formation and doesn't search for the truth.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Cans first. They say conspiracies never get solved on an empty stomach anyway.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_13b_food_priority.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. Food and order first. We'll get to the truth if we survive this night.
Quest side mvp 14a open truth: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Better a painful truth than a convenient lie before a new strike.
Quest side mvp 14a open truth: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.choice.open.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go out to the people and say it without pretty packaging. Better they hear a tremor in my voice than a new lie.
  • नेथन कोल→माया चेनquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We tell the truth ourselves before rumors do it for us. We control the blow instead of putting out the fire later.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The truth belongs to everyone. Hiding it from the bunker means deciding for people as if they were children.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→माया चेनquest_side_mvp_14a_open_truth.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Alright, we tell the truth, even if it hurts.
Quest side mvp 14b quiet order: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We won the night. Tomorrow, we'll have to pay for this silence.
Quest side mvp 14b quiet order: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll keep the panic down, but people there have lost family. They need at least a drop of truth, not just orders.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll say the minimum, but keep a record of what we hid, and Untracked Lie will later explode harder than the truth.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We dose the information. Right now, we need the ranks together, not a collective nervous breakdown.
  • नेथन कोल→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_14b_quiet_order.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. First we keep people in order. Then we'll deal with the truth.
Quest side mvp 15a family evac: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Today, we saved the very people we hold this bunker for.
Quest side mvp 15a family evac: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go for the families. If the bunker can't open its door to children, it's already empty inside.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll get them out, but recon goes first. The rescue mustn't lead the waves straight to the bunker.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If we get the families out, the people in the bunker will understand again why they hold the walls. It'll pay off in morale.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_15a_family_evac.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go for the people. Let it cost us pace, but not our humanity.
Quest side mvp 15b hunt organizer: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yes, at least now there's less chance it'll happen again tomorrow.
Quest side mvp 15b hunt organizer: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go after him, but the families in the block mustn't become a price that's convenient not to see.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We go after him, but no blind chase. If it's bait, we won't hand him half the squad.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We hit his gang. As long as he has fighters, any families we save will become targets again.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_side_mvp_15b_hunt_organizer.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. We cut off the head of the chain while it's within striking distance.
Quest side mvp 16a rescue engineers: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Excellent. So, our chances for tomorrow have become a bit more honest.
Quest side mvp 16a rescue engineers: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm going into the Metro to pull the group out. Then they can explain themselves how to keep the lights from dying.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We get the engineers out. One person with the power circuit layout is worth a whole warehouse of hardware right now.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We won't abandon people just because silent victims are more convenient for the reactor.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We get them out. Without people who know the system, we've already lost.
Quest side mvp 16b secure reactor: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We held the bunker. Now we have to survive the price of that order.
Quest side mvp 16b secure reactor: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We stabilize the circuit step-by-step. Measurement, cutoff, reserve. The reactor doesn't forgive flashy moves.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We run the circuit hot and win the night. If it holds, we can argue about protocols later.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We close the emergency circuit now. If the lights go out, all other decisions become theory.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. We stabilize the reactor, even if we'll come to hate this decision later.
Quest side mvp 17a test serum: Choice (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.ethics.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go in, but the right to stop the test will be yours, not Liang's and not the system's.
Quest side mvp 17a test serum: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.aftermath.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll talk to them, without promising miracles. I'll just tell the truth and ask them to stick together while we still can.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file But something remained. I remember a movement I never learned. Record that separately from the report to the system.
Quest side mvp 17a test serum: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.choice.people.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If I start forgetting names or speaking someone else's words, pull me out immediately. Data later.
  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.choice.protocol.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We tested on me. Two short cycles. A log of every reaction. Emergency shutdown in Natalie's hands.
  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.choice.risk.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm going into the circuit. No safety pauses. Run the full cycle straight away. If the rule holds, I want to know how much it can take.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The system proposed someone else, so we'll check how much it needs the result when I'm the one taking the risk.
Quest side mvp 17b destroy serum: Choice (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.ethics.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then we cut to the quick, but without blood. We remove the risk now and look for another chance later.
Quest side mvp 17b destroy serum: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.aftermath.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hope isn't in a test tube, it's in the fact that we're still alive and holding on to each other. I'll explain to them why we did it.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Today, we chose people over a formula. Tomorrow, we'll look for a way where no one goes into the circuit without the right to say no.
Quest side mvp 17b destroy serum: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.start.choice.containment.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, isolation and cleanup. We'll burn only what can kill us today, without panic and showy bonfires.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.start.choice.data.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We destroy the batch, but not the work. We keep the protocols, logs, and conclusions so the next chance is cleaner.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.start.choice.people.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If it's a choice between a formula and people, the formula loses. We'll look for another way later, but alive.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Right now, it's more important that the team lives until morning. Without people, no formula will help us anymore.
Quest side test dog taming: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोलखुशquest_side_test_dog_taming.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hey, buddy, who left you here?

  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_side_test_dog_taming.start.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Emily, there's a dog tied to a fence here in the parking lot. Friendly. How do you feel about dogs?
Quest trade automaton intro: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सtrade_automaton_done.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Purchase complete. The vending machine is happy. I'm wary.
Quest trade automaton intro: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सtrade_automaton_intro.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Water and something edible first. If the machine breaks the laws of physics, it can at least feed people.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सtrade_automaton_intro.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll buy the cheapest thing and check what it does with the credits. Miracles get tested on small things first.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सtrade_automaton_intro.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If it asks for a tip, I'll officially start being afraid of this bunker.
Quest trade scavenger intro: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→कबाड़ीtrade_scavenger_intro.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You'll see about that. What have you got?
  • नेथन कोल<en> Contempt→कबाड़ीtrade_scavenger_intro.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file And how much of someone else's blood is in that?

Quest trade wanderer intro: Start (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→पथिकtrade_wanderer_intro.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Everyone says that until they're within firing range.

Quest trial david 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_trial_david_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then, lock down the channel and copy everything twice. If that was real, we'll need the trail later.
Quest trial david 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_trial_david_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the access starts pressing on you, drop the channel. A person matters more than synchronization.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→डेविड किमquest_trial_david_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Backup channel and an exit point first. Synchronization without a retreat is a trap.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_trial_david_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Window, Channel, Cover. Give the signal. I'll shut down the threat without unnecessary words.
  • नेथन कोल→डेविड किमquest_trial_david_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You crack it, I'll cover. Just don't play hero with the access. Anything that crawls onto the channel is mine.
Quest trial emily 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_trial_emily_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We made it, thanks to you. See to the wounded. I'll hand out water and count who made it out.
Quest trial emily 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_trial_emily_01.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If someone can't be carried out quickly, we mark the spot and move on. Otherwise, we'll lose everyone.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_trial_emily_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Living First. I'll cover the passage, and you tell me who needs a hand right now.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_trial_emily_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We keep the route narrow. Entrance, evacuation, control of the wounded. No rushes.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_trial_emily_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm with you. You tell me who we pull out first, I hold the passage.
Quest trial india 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→इंडिया रायनquest_trial_india_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We pulled through because you didn't lose your nerve. Write down the root while your hands still remember.
Quest trial india 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→इंडिया रायनquest_trial_india_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We keep the pace, but cut corners only where there's a margin for error.
  • नेथन कोल→इंडिया रायनquest_trial_india_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You lead the route. I push the pace. If something's in the way, we break through.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→इंडिया रायनquest_trial_india_01.start.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let's fly low, but without a pretty crater at the end. I want to come back with a story, not a legend.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→इंडिया रायनquest_trial_india_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You lead the route. I'll mark the point and won't let the pace turn into a crash.
Quest trial liam 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_trial_liam_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good. Record the result and let people breathe out.
Quest trial liam 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_trial_liam_01.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If part of the group holds up the rest, we cut the pace in favor of the majority. Otherwise, we won't get anyone out.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_trial_liam_01.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We split the corridor into sections. Front edge, middle, retreat. No one runs off on their own.
  • नेथन कोल→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_trial_liam_01.start.choice.shield.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Civilians go out first. I hold the line until the last one is behind my back.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_trial_liam_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll take the front edge. You lead the civilians. I'll report if the corridor starts to crumble.
Quest trial marcos 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_trial_marcos_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Done. Legs intact? Head too. Let's keep going.
Quest trial marcos 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_trial_marcos_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If someone gets stuck in the sector, the sweep can wait. We don't write people off for a nice pace.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_trial_marcos_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Entrances and flanks first. A clean zone is worth nothing if we ourselves fall in the passage.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_trial_marcos_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We clear it fast. The target falls. The sector is ours. No one has time to get scared.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_trial_marcos_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. Fast, clean, no improvising. Just how you like it.
Quest trial maya 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→माया चेनquest_trial_maya_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You held the nodes. We held the ground. That's how we keep working.
Quest trial maya 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_trial_maya_01.start.choice.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We count the losses before they happen. Humanity is easier to keep when there's a plan.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_trial_maya_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If someone falters, we cover them and get them out. Chaos won't get the right to decide for us.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_trial_maya_01.start.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We don't bargain with conscience. Even if the fight gets dirty, the rules inside us must survive.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→माया चेनquest_trial_maya_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Moving out. If it comes down to a choice between speed and people, remind me in time.
Quest trial nataly 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_trial_nataly_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We have the facts. Now, let's lay them out so they don't break those who will have to hear them.
Quest trial nataly 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_trial_nataly_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We gather data in small steps. If the matrix starts lying, we stop and verify the source.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_trial_nataly_01.start.choice.facts.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go into the thick of the signal myself. If the matrix is lying somewhere, I want to see it up close.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_trial_nataly_01.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If part of the data breaks people, we'll leave it behind a closed door until better times.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_trial_nataly_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got it. I'll see it with my own eyes. And you keep me grounded in the facts, even if they're unpleasant.
Quest trial nathan 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Sad→सिस्टमquest_trial_nathan_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The trial doesn't let go. Let's take a breath and keep going.
Quest trial nathan 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_trial_nathan_01.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the trial is testing me, let it test what matters most, how many people I get out alive.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Angry→सिस्टमquest_trial_nathan_01.start.choice.defiance.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Immediate execution? No, the decision is mine. I'll start because people need a result.
  • नेथन कोल→सिस्टमquest_trial_nathan_01.start.choice.discipline.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The scheme will be simple. I see the threat, hold the formation, get people out. No pretty mistakes.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_trial_nathan_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Starting, we keep the link up as long as there's air.
Quest trial oliver 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_trial_oliver_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Your project held up. Now, lock in the result before it decides to be a one-night miracle.
Quest trial oliver 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_trial_oliver_01.start.choice.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the circuit can handle an overload, we'll test it right away. Better to find the limit now than in the dark.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_trial_oliver_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Give me the node and the order of operations. I'll hold the circuit. You guide me through the schematic.
  • नेथन कोल→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_trial_oliver_01.start.choice.protocol.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We work by the protocol. Power. Reserve. Cutoff. No miracles in place of the schematic.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_trial_oliver_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Copy. I'll keep the circuit alive. You tell me where I shouldn't even breathe on the wires.
Quest trial sera 01: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_trial_sera_01.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nowhere. I just really didn't want us to be heard.
Quest trial sera 01: Start (4)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_trial_sera_01.start.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll go first. If someone has to find out how quietly we can get through, let it be me.
  • नेथन कोल→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_trial_sera_01.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Name the target, I'll close it. No unnecessary words and no fancy maneuvers.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_trial_sera_01.start.choice.humor.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If anything, I'll be the quietest hero in history, almost without posing.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_trial_sera_01.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Understood. I'll keep the line steady. If you see a gap, shout it on the channel right away.

Quest tutor 02: End (2)
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_02.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Light and a map first. If Nora is in the city, it'll be easier to find her from here.

Quest tutor 02: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubtquest_tutor_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No, that's not her voice, but someone clearly needs help.

  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_02.emily_meet.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We can't get there through the streets. Too many of these creatures.
Quest tutor 03: End (1)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Me neither. But if this thing gives us a chance, we'll use it. Carefully.
Quest tutor 03: Start (10)
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.light_on.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We have light. Now sit down, catch your breath, we'll figure out the rest together.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.light_on.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Light makes it easier to take stock. Let's see what here we can actually put to use.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.light_on.choice.principle.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We have light, and the first rule of this place? Nobody goes into the dark alone.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.map_outside.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll mark the hospital. But first, I scout the approaches. We're not going in blind.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.map_outside.choice.open.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm scared too. But now, we have somewhere to come back to. And if the hospital is on the route, we'll check it.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.map_outside.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then the map isn't hope, it's roots. Exits, supplies, the hospital. We mark everything.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.start.choice.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll get the lights on. Meanwhile, don't go digging through the rubble alone, okay?
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.start.choice.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll take the generator. You hold the flashlight and tell me right away if you hear anything.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_03.start.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Without a generator, this is just concrete. First, whatever gives us power, the rest can wait.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubtquest_tutor_03.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A terminal, not a speck of dust on it. And everything else here is buried in it. Someone expected us to come. I don't trust gifts like that.
Quest tutor 03: Unused (2)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Contemptquest_tutor_03.step_03.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Funny, the world is collapsing and I'm starting with cleaning up again.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→सिस्टमquest_tutor_03.step_04.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Do you hear yourself? Like you're reading the manual to your own life? Fine. Show me.
Quest tutor 04: End (3)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_04.return_fuel.choice.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file First, we calculate fuel consumption and supplies. Then, we decide what to build.
  • नेथन कोलखुश→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_04.return_fuel.choice.open.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Thank you. Really. I didn't expect anyone here to be thinking about me.
  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_04.return_fuel.choice.pragmatic.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We've bought a day of life. Now the main thing is to spend it only on what improves our survival.
Quest tutor 04: Start (5)
  • नेथन कोल<en> Afraidquest_tutor_04.step_01.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If I have to go outside anyway, better to do it with a purpose, not in a panic.
  • नेथन कोल<en> Doubtquest_tutor_04.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There it is. I need to gather at least three canisters or the generator will die again.

  • नेथन कोल→एमिली रिवर्सquest_tutor_04.start.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If I stay, it'll go out anyway. Lock the entrance, don't open it for anyone, and stay close to the radio. Three canisters, and I'll come straight back.
Quest tutor 04b psi impulse: Emily talk (1)

<en> Pickup fractal ext hoverboard (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_pickup_fractal_ext_hoverboard_01@emily.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A hoverboard fractal! If the lab can crack it, I'll fly like in the movies.
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_pickup_fractal_ext_hoverboard_02@emily.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file This thing kept the mech in the air, taking it to the lab.
<en> Tutorial: rest (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_tut_rest_emily_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A bed. Almost a real one.<en> Game text A bed! Almost a real one.
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_tut_rest_emily_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Wake me if the world ends again.<en> Game text Wake me if the world ends again.
<en> Unarmed at a door (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_door_emily_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Ow! That's not going to break it.<en> Game text Ow! That's not going to break it.
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_door_emily_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm not strong enough. I need something heavier.<en> Game text I'm not strong enough. I need something heavier.
<en> Unarmed at a door (<en> generic) (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_door_generic_01@emily.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Fists won't break this door.
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_door_generic_02@emily.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll just hurt my hands. I need a weapon.
<en> Unarmed at glass (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_glass_emily_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll cut myself. I need something to break it with.<en> Game text I'll cut myself! I need something to break it with.
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_glass_emily_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Not with my hands. I'll use something.<en> Game text Not with my hands. I'll use something.
<en> Unarmed at glass (<en> generic) (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_glass_generic_01@emily.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Punch glass bare-handed? I'll cut myself.
  • एमिली रिवर्सloc_chatter_unarmed_glass_generic_02@emily.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Better break the glass with a weapon.

<en> Story dialogue (125)

Quest ending acceptance: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_ending_acceptance.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Nora talking to you now won't bring your daughter back. You know that. Can you let go of the past and let her be herself?
Quest ending acceptance: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_ending_acceptance.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need to talk about Nora, not the one you're looking for, the one who exists now. I'll help you separate the memory from her, but whether you're ready to let go is your decision.
Quest ending consent: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_ending_consent.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The link to her is ready. Tell her everything as it is. One core, no copies, nothing beyond this world. Then, just listen to her. It's her choice.
Quest main 02: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_02.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The containers are intact. A separate protocol for these samples has appeared in the laboratory. Choose it. The other research won't help us right now.
Quest main 05: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_05.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file At least you have some protection now. Still, don't let your guard down, okay?
Quest main 05: Start (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_05.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You have almost no protection. Set up the workshops, make weapons and armor. I feel calmer when there's at least something between you and their teeth.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_05.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The workshop is ready. Make a reliable weapon. I know how to heal, but it's better to do without that.
Quest main 06: End (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_06.end.park.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Enough blood for today. Seeds instead. The old records put them in the park greenhouse. I've marked it on the map. There's a radio signal nearby too. Check it while you're there.
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_06.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You're back. Let me take a look. The raid was stopped. We can breathe out. At least for a little while.
Quest main 06: Start (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_06.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I caught their chatter on the radio. The bandits notice the generator and want to take it, along with our supplies. Their leader is gathering people by the warehouses. If we wait, they'll come right to our door.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_06.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file They call in reinforcements through two alarm transmitters. Switch them off and the fight will be easier. But if you decide to go straight for the leader, stay away from getting surrounded.
Quest main 07: End (12)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.system.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I understand. If we don't do anything about them, we might regret it later.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Some kind of interface popped up for me too. It says something about them. I just can't tell what yet.
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.survivors.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll deal with the bandits, too. But first, let's help those who need it most.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.06.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Did it give you the next task? Maybe that will clear something up.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Surprised→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.08.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's something else. I went through the notes and trophies from the camp. There's not only supplies there, there are traces of other people.
  • एमिली रिवर्स→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.10.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let's look for other survivors. You held out in the park on your own, Marcos. So there could be others. I'd start there.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.12.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file But your brain wasn't washed. Maybe you're not the only one?
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.14.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If they strike at night, the generator will be their first target, and the infirmary right after it.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.16.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file But it's the same with the survivors. If we delay, there may be no one left to find.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.18.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I think the bandits can wait a day or two. Nothing will happen. But for the survivors, those days could be their last. I'd start with them.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_07.end.20.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So are yours. Nathan, what do you say?
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.22.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I won't be offended if you decide to deal with the bandits first. But I'm worried about the survivors. It's right that you're the one to choose.
Quest main 07: Start (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, willpower alone won't carry us any further. This interface in my head scares me, but it's also a chance. We have to learn to use it, or we'll be crushed.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It sounds insane, but if the world now runs on rules, let's learn to use them.
Quest main 08b: Choice (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_08b.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The direct way. We'll get there sooner, but it's more dangerous. The detour. Longer, but a better chance of coming back. I'm... afraid of getting it wrong.
Quest main 08b: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_08b.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The signal was repeating on a loop. There was no one left alive in the camp, just a body by the transmitter and an ambush. We were too late.
Quest main 08b: Start (2)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_08b.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Someone on the outskirts is calling for help. The voice was trembling, just like a child's. I can't pretend I didn't hear it.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_08b.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If there were people here, they may have left notes. Sometimes one sentence saves more than a medkit.
Quest main 09b: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_09b.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Empty, but the tracks are fresh and there's no blood. Whoever was hiding here left on their own, alive.
Quest main 09b: Start (3)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_09b.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two entrances. One is closer, but it's an open street. The other is farther through the courtyards. I'm afraid of making too much noise.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_09b.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The warehouse on the outskirts. If someone was hiding there, they may have run out of water and strength. I won't survive another. We were too late.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_09b.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Go quietly inside. People like to rig traps in warehouses, and someone could be hiding in the dark.
Quest main 14: End (4)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.end.04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Welcome. If you need anything, bandages, medicine, or just some quiet, find me in the infirmary.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.12.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I don't know if the system is helping us or just using us, but so far, its tasks have led us to people and supplies. I'd do this one too, and see what happens after.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_14.end.18.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm with Liam. The labs can wait, and whoever goes in there first will end up on my table afterwards.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.end.27.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A sad story, but the main thing, Seraphina, is that you survived.
Quest main 14: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's a trade signal coming from the Metro. Yes, it could be a trap. But we're nearly out of bandages and antiseptic, and people are already fighting over every pill. If there's someone to trade with down there, I wanna know who.
Quest main defense intro: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलdefense_intro.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The barricades are up. Now we have at least a couple of minutes between they're coming and they're here.
Quest main defense intro: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलdefense_intro.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We're settled in, but the generators loud and stray creatures are already coming to the noise. Put up five barricades at the entrance. We know the layout. Turrets and upgrades need fractals. You find them on runs and study them in the lab.
Quest main park greenhouse: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_park_greenhouse.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The water's flowing. I heard the pump start up over the radio. First sprouts in a week. Strange to be happy about green things with all this around us.
Quest main park greenhouse: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_park_greenhouse.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Guardian's dead, so the park greenhouse is ours again. Get the irrigation running and Marcos' seeds will sprout. Then we can stop splitting every can.
Quest personal emily 01: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_emily_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You're okay? Good. Now we have both a cot and equipment. Thank you. I feel calmer when I have something to help you with.
Quest personal emily 01: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_emily_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If you come back with a serious wound, bandages alone won't be enough. There's an ambulance left in the suburb. See if the equipment survived. Meanwhile, I'll prepare a clean corner for an aid station.
Quest personal emily 02: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_personal_emily_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I managed to read it. The last entry is a hospital ward downtown. I know that doesn't mean anything yet, but I have no other address.
Quest personal emily 02: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_emily_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file An evacuation archive turned up in an old terminal. Damaged. What if there's a record of my brother? The aid station equipment needs upgrading, or the file can't be recovered.
Quest personal emily 03: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_emily_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No one? I see. No, that doesn't mean he's dead yet. We just don't know. Thank you for checking. I need to be alone for a little while.
Quest personal emily 03: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_emily_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The ward downtown is the last address from the archive. Maybe my brother left some trace there. Please check and come back. I'm not asking you to risk yourself for my hope.
Quest personal emily lab archive: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलemily_lab_archive.end.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The schematics survived. I've restored the full fractal. Now it can be researched. Thank you for taking on my request.
Quest personal emily lab archive: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलemily_lab_archive.start.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I have a favor to ask. Mine, not the system's. There's a technical archive for lab equipment left in the industrial zone. Bring it to me. With the schematics, I can restore the fractal.
Quest personal nathan 00: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_00.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Okay, but if you ever want to talk, I'm here.
Quest personal nathan 00: Start (4)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_00.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, can I ask you something? On the first day, you were looking for a girl. Nora, who is she to you? And where did you lose each other?
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_00.start.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file And ever since, you've been looking for her on every map. I see how you look at the markers.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Surprised→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_00.start.05.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Why?
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_00.start.07.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My brother might still be alive somewhere. You already buried yours and kept searching anyway. That's not madness, Nathan. It's love with nowhere left to go.
Quest side mvp 09a civilians first: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Thank you. Today, there won't be a list of those we lost because of an empty shelf in the aid station.
Quest side mvp 09a civilians first: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_09a_civilians_first.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, our people are dying, not from claws, but from a lack of basic medicine. If we don't choose them now, in the morning I'll be explaining to the children why we were too late.
Quest side mvp 10a refugee convoy: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We got them out. Tonight, these people will sleep under a roof, not in a ditch.
Quest side mvp 10a refugee convoy: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_10a_refugee_convoy.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, we have a column of civilians with no cover. If we don't lead them now, by morning only empty cars and traces of blood will be left there.
Quest side mvp 11a prisoner exchange: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Their home. Today we chose people, not fear. Thank you.
Quest side mvp 11a prisoner exchange: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_11a_prisoner_exchange.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We can bring the living back today. Yes, he'll get away. But if we start counting people as expendable, we'll become just like them.
Quest side mvp 12a school evac: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_12a_school_evac.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Everyone's out. They're trembling, but alive. Thank you.
Quest side mvp 12a school evac: Start (1)

Quest side mvp 15a family evac: End (1)

Quest side mvp 15a family evac: Start (1)

Quest trial emily 01: Start (1)

Quest tutor 02: End (3)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We're inside, so the bunker is intact after all.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.end.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nora, that red-haired girl you were asking about? Who is she to you?

Quest tutor 02: Start (7)
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.ctl_wheel.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's a weapon wheel too. Scroll it and pick what to fight with.
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.emily_meet.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Thank you. I'm Emily. You showed up just in time.
  • एमिली रिवर्स→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.quickslots.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Keep your weapons close. Melee, one-handed, two-handed. You can swap on the move without digging through your bag.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.step_04.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the manhole cover isn't jammed, we'll have a chance to lose them.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hey, over here! Please, they're close.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.emily_meet.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I haven't. I'm sorry. It all happened too fast. But we can't stay here. There's an old civil defense bunker under the city.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_02.emily_meet.05.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's a way through the sewers. The manhole should be nearby.
Quest tutor 03: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Those lines in the air again. Now they're drawing roots too. I can't get used to the city looking like a map.
Quest tutor 03: Start (3)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If this place doesn't collapse, we'll have a roof, but it's dark here, and that's scarier than up there.
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_03.step_01.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It works. With the lights on, it's not so scary here anymore.
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_03.step_07.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Going out again scares me. But next time, I'm coming with you. My brother was in the hospital when it all started. I'm looking for someone too.
Quest tutor 04: End (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_04.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You're back. With fuel. While you were gone, I cleared the rubble and stitched you a chest guard from what I found. You're going out again anyway. At least wear this. The rest is in storage.
Quest tutor 04: Start (1)
  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_04.start.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, wait! You're leaving right now? I don't even know what's locked behind these doors. What if the lights go out before you get back?

Quest tutor 04b psi impulse: End (1)

Quest tutor 05: Start (5)

  • एमिली रिवर्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_05.step_03.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Now, at least, we have a place to recover our strength.
Quest tutor 06: End (1)

Quest tutor 07: End (1)

Quest tutor 07: Start (4)

  • एमिली रिवर्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_tutor_07.start.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I think it's saying we don't understand the anomalies we've found. We need a laboratory, preferably far from the living blocks.
