<en> Story dialogue (71)

Quest ending evacuation: End (1)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→नेथन कोलquest_ending_evacuation.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The route is checked. We all go out, in turns, undercover. And we've got somewhere to fall back to.
Quest ending evacuation: Start (1)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→नेथन कोलquest_ending_evacuation.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need a way out for everyone. Not just the lucky ones. Walk the route through the industrial zone and come back alive. Nobody in this operation is expendable.
Quest main 04: Start (4)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़खुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_04.step_05.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Well, at least someone here can still shoot. Thanks.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़खुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_04.step_02.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So, the radio did reach someone alive after all. Marcos, glad you're not a recording on loop.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_04.step_02.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll get acquainted later. Hear that? They're coming. First, let's live long enough to talk.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→नेथन कोलquest_main_04.step_05.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Lead the way. I've still got seeds from the local greenhouse. We'll take them to the bunker. And I'll be useful on outings, too.
Quest main 07: End (11)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.survivors.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Well, your choice. I respect it.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.system.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Emily, Stow the Panic. Ours is hardly the only bunker. Whoever's held out this long can last a couple more days. Then, we deal with the rest.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Same here. Nathan, did the system explain anything to you? Anything at all?
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Surprised→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.05.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So the system explained nothing, but it's already demanding we dig deeper?
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.09.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Spill it, Emily.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Angry→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.11.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I've seen survivors there. Bandits. Talking is useless. It's like the system washed their brains. Nothing to expect but trouble.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.13.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Maybe, but I'd focus on something else. You took out their leader, but his people didn't go anywhere. They've regrouped in a camp in the suburb. It's a stone's throw from the bunker, and judging by their fuss, they're preparing something.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.15.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It'll be worse if we miss our moment and they make the first move.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.17.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Maybe. But right now, it's our own lives on the line first.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_07.end.19.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Fair enough, except the survivors have no coordinates, and the bandits' fires are visible from our roof.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_07.end.21.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Yeah, Nathan. Your call. If we go after the survivors, we risk exposing ourselves to the bandits. If we put it off, we may not find the survivors in time. Emily's right about that.
Quest main 10: End (1)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_10.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file That's it. They've pulled back. Reload. They may come again.
Quest main 10: Start (2)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_10.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The defenses are ready. Now we can build the stabilizer by the entrance. It will provide components for upgrades, but its signal will attract monsters. Check the garrison before you start it.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Angry→नेथन कोलquest_main_10.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file This isn't about heroics now. It's about the line. Don't let them push through it.
Quest main 11: Start (2)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_11.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need fortifications. Turrets, barricades, anything that buys us a couple of seconds. There might still be blueprints and metal in the industrial zone. Go, before it gets really bad out there.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_11.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The industrial zone is a bad place. Silence there doesn't mean clear. More often, it means waiting.
Quest main 13: End (1)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़खुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_13.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Now we can breathe. A pack without a head becomes just noise, not a death sentence.
Quest main 13: Start (2)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_13.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A creature has risen in the park, the kind the pack follows like a banner. If we don't take the leader down, the residential sectors will turn into a meat grinder tonight.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Angry→नेथन कोलquest_main_13.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The Guardian isn't just a beast. It's the pack's signal. Drop it and you save a dozen fights.
Quest main 14: End (8)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Angry→नैटली ब्रूक्सquest_main_14.end.natalie_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A stranger's voice on our channel. Who are you? And where you hold up?
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.06.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Trading is good, but what do we do next? Nathan, any new tasks from the system?
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_14.end.11.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hold your horses. Are you even sure this is a good idea? We don't even know what this system is, and now it wants us to install antennas for it.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.end.15.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Worth checking. RECOM won't hurt.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.end.19.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We'll handle the dangers, not our first time.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Surprised→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_14.end.28.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So, if we don't go set up the antennas right now, we lose the system's assignment.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.30.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The timer won't wait while we argue. We have to decide now.
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.31.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, you're the leader. Whatever you say, we'll do.
Quest main 14: Start (1)
  • मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Traders are just bandits with a counter. It's not buy and sell here. It's who blinks first. Don't blink.

<en> Story dialogue (28)

Quest main 11: Choice (3)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_11.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two exits, just like a fire call. The direct one's faster, but under fire. The detour's longer, but there's cover. Your call.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_11.intro.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hey, don't shoot! I'm friendly! Liam O'Connor, firefighter. Well, I was, until the city decided to burn off schedule.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_11.intro.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The only one left from my whole shift, but let's not get gloomy, my shield stops bullets, tested, fortifying a bunker? I'm in!
Quest main 11: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_11.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Metal, check. Blueprints, check. Firefighter included. The next wave won't wipe us out in a minute.
Quest main 12: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_12.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There we go. Not a win yet, but we're not helpless anymore.
Quest main 12: Start (2)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_12.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We start with barricades around the perimeter. Then, a machine gun turret and a mortar. In order, each piece holds up the next.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर→नेथन कोलquest_main_12.step_02.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Place it so it survives the first hit. Let the walls shake, but not the people.
Quest main 14: End (7)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Useful thing. Finally, we can trade, not just shoot.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.09.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let me see...
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.10.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It's all clear. I can do this.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.16.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No, I think Seraphina is right. Even if the laboratories have something about the system, I don't think we'll get that information so easily.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.end.17.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file So, let's just do what the system asks. The answers will turn up in time.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Surprised→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_14.end.21.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Hang on. The system gave us a deadline for the Antennas. Where'd that come from? It never rushed us before.
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.29.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The labs won't go anywhere overnight. The timer will.
Quest main 22: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_22.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The headquarters is destroyed, and we have the orders. It was reconnaissance before a big strike. Now we know the direction.
Quest main 22: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_22.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The line held, but the bandits are already pulling back to their headquarters. If we let them get away with the orders, the next attack will be more precise.
Quest main 28: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_28.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The gates held. The wave choked before it reached the doors. The lights are on. Tonight, the airport is ours.
Quest main 28: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_28.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The airport is ours while it's light. At 1830, it gets dark, and everything hiding in the hangers will crawl onto the field. Get the runway lights on, switch on the landing beacon, and close the emergency gates at the checkpoint. Then, we'll make it through the night.
Quest main 35: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_35.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Karkan is down. The route is breathing again, but don't relax. The pack will still look for a weak spot.
Quest main 35: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_35.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Karkan is tearing up our roots. Either we deal with him now, or we're left without supplies.
Quest personal liam 01: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liam_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There! Now we can see the suburb! If the creatures come this way, at least we'll have time to get ready. And you said it'd be a lot of hassle. Okay, you didn't say that. But you could have!
Quest personal liam 01: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liam_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Four cameras in the suburb, a screen in the bunker, and at least we'll see what's crawling toward us. Otherwise, we just sit and wait for something to slam into the door. So, shall we get to it?
Quest personal liam 02: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Surprised→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liam_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Timestamps match to the frame. Cameras are fine. So it's not three angles on one event. It's three different versions of one place. Creepy, huh?
Quest personal liam 02: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liam_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's one camera at the gate, but the feed runs through three relays, in the industrial zone, downtown, and the port. And each one has its own version. People walk through, the gate is shut, there are no people at all. The timestamps match.
Quest personal liam 03: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liam_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file No one. Thanks for checking. I'd never have forgiven myself if we hadn't even tried.
Quest personal liam 03: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liam_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There may still be survivors in the port. Check it out. If someone there is waiting for help, I don't want to wonder later whether we'd have made it in time.
Quest trial liam 01: End (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनरखुश→नेथन कोलquest_trial_liam_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The line held! Every civilian's safe. That's what it's worth walking into fire for.
Quest trial liam 01: Start (1)
  • लियाम ओ'कॉनर<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_trial_liam_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Narrow corridor, threats on every side, and civilians behind us. Nathan, we grab the people and get out!

<en> Story dialogue (50)

Quest ending evidence: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_ending_evidence.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We checked separately, and the conclusions match. The Phoenix threat to other worlds is real. It's no longer my opinion or David's.
Quest ending evidence: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_ending_evidence.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My archive is just words. We need David's field data, gathered without my conclusions. If two independent sources agree, that's a finding, not a promise from the system.
Quest main 14: End (2)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.natalie_01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Do you copy? Sorry to cut in. Your trade channel is open and I can hear every word. My name is Natalie.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.natalie_03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A survivor, same as you. I'm hiding on the other side of the city, and I'm not asking to move in, but I know more about those labs than I'd like to.
Quest main 15b: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_15b.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two ways. The fast one will give more data, but the risk is higher. The careful one is safer, but we might lose the trail. I... don't want to make a mistake.
Quest main 15b: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_15b.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Thank you. Now it's not, it seems. These are facts, and they frightened me more than guesses did.
Quest main 15b: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_15b.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I heard you're going to the laboratories after all. There's an old system node there. Too many matches with what we're seeing now. I need data, or we'll be treating the symptoms again without understanding the disease.
Quest main 17: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_17.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The channel is real, and the strangest thing is that Phoenix answers as if she knows your train of thought before we do. That's not a person, and not an ordinary program.
Quest main 17: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_17.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Phoenix has made contact, and that name shouldn't come up for nothing. She's calling us to a meeting and is clearly hiding something. We need data from the site, or we're guessing in the dark.
Quest main 20: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_20.start.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need intel, but the place is full of hardware, and I know you'll be tempted. How are you going in?
Quest main 20: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Surprised→नेथन कोलquest_main_20.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file This isn't just a camp. They have a trade network, marks on old maps, and information on the movements of survivors.
Quest main 20: Start (2)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_20.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file After the mech business, we've got a new problem. A bandit camp has dug in by the market, and they're not just looting. They're keeping records of roots.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_20.start.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Exactly. I need their records. Who trades with them, where they go, and what they know about us. Just don't clear the place for the sake of it. Recon first.
Quest main 20: Step (2)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_20.camp_entrance.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Remember the rotation order. Fortresses fell less off into their walls than to someone who had memorized the guard schedule.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_20.office.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Take the log and everything you can carry out quietly. Paper is sometimes more dangerous than weapons.
Quest main 21: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_21.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I saw it up close. It glowed like a system node. I'm done listening to all this over the radio. If you'll let me, I'm coming with you from here.
Quest main 21: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_21.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file An anomaly has appeared in the zone, glowing, alive, or something like alive. It could be a chance, or bait. We need to see it with our own eyes before the trail disappears.
Quest main 25: End (5)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_25.end.17.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A failure is a rare window. If the terminals are open for repair, we might see not the interface, but what lies beneath it.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_25.end.22.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If we go repair the terminals, we'll get access to their internal channels.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_25.end.23.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We can pull data, where the signals go, what commands pass through the port, and who actually speaks on behalf of the system.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_25.end.24.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the system notices the interference, we'll lose the reward, possibly its tolerance, too.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटquest_main_25.end.29.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I agree, but without risk, we'll stay forever inside someone else's version of events.
Quest main 26b: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_26b.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We can take the data different ways. Quietly. Fewer guards, but less data too. Greedy. We pull more, but the defenses will come running from the whole district. Your call.
Quest main 26b: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_26b.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Look, all the routing converges on the airport. Commands for every group in the city go through it, not just ours.
Quest main 26b: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_26b.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There are three terminals left downtown. Each has its own fragment of the system's routing. Let's get to the first one. There, we'll decide how deep to dig.
Quest main 27b: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_27b.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two routes. One is closer, but more nerve-wracking. The other is farther, but the chance of coming back is higher. Your call.
Quest main 27b: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_27b.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Look, the Anomalies pulse in the same rhythm, as if someone were synchronizing clocks across the whole city. This isn't chaos, it could be the key.
Quest main 27b: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_27b.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I've decrypted part of the data array, but without field samples, it'll be a beautiful lie. We need to collect more data on the anomalies before the zone digests all the traces.
Quest main 37b: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_37b.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two ways. Through the survivor's nodes. Slower, but we don't put people at risk. Through the system's relays. More precise, but security will follow us. We have to choose now.
Quest main 37b: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_37b.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Three nodes converge on one point. The core wasn't hiding. It was waiting for us to learn how to count.
Quest main 37b: Start (2)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_37b.start.route.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The city nodes are dead. The system burned them out while we were at the port. What's left? The substation and the beacon at the airport, the port channel, and the antenna in the mountain complex, right by the core.
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_37b.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Since we're taking the survivor's route, we need as much data as possible to calculate the course coordinates. One wrong node, and we miss by a whole district.
Quest main 40: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_40.end.release_reply.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Distress signals are coming in. The war has already begun. Did the people in those worlds know you decided for them, Nathan?
Quest main market medicine: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_market_medicine.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We have the medicine. Eight addresses on the list, and half of them still answer the call sign. So, the city's alive.
Quest main market medicine: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_market_medicine.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Their records have an inventory. Antibiotics, insulin, bandages, who they took them from and when. It's all dumped in the supermarket's cold storage. I want to give it back to people, not trade it away.
Quest main metro shard: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_metro_shard.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Got the recording. The channel's closed, and the header is a single word. Phoenix. I don't know who that is, but they're listening to the same airwaves we are.
Quest main metro shard: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_main_metro_shard.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A shard of that crystal is still broadcasting. Not noise. Packets. With a header I can't read. Hook a relay up to it. I need a clean recording.
Quest personal nataly 01: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nataly_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The defense is held and you still manage to connect the portal? Start with that. I need the details, even the boring ones, especially the boring ones. Nobody usually writes those down.
Quest personal nataly 01: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nataly_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I want to check the Institute's archive. I don't know what survived there. But leaving it unexamined? No. Check the entrance. Just be careful.
Quest personal nataly 02: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्सखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nataly_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It opens. Let me finish reading. Yes, I know you just got back. Thank you.
Quest personal nataly 02: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nataly_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The system has locked me out of the archive. There's a terminal in the Metro. Set up three jammers and retrieve the data. I want to see what it won't let me read.
Quest personal nataly 03: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nataly_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The logs contradict each other. The first shows the reserve being lost. The second shows it being redirected seconds before the failure. This wasn't a random accident.
Quest personal nataly 03: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nataly_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm trying to stay calm, but there's almost no time. The airport lost power in seconds, too cleanly for an accident. The logs are still on the power panels. Get both, Nathan. We'll decide based on them, not on rumors.
Quest personal nathan 03: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_03.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file How you tell them is your call, but it decides who we become after this night.
Quest personal nathan 03: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Thank you. Now we have not only facts, but a decision no one will hide behind.
Quest personal nathan 03: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You brought back more from the lab than you wanted to. The team is already whispering. Decide how to tell them, Nathan, before rumors decide for you.
Quest side mvp 17a test serum: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_17a_test_serum.ethics.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The system named as a suitable carrier, a person who can't refuse. That's not a volunteer. If the test is necessary, the one who made the decision steps into the circuit.
Quest side mvp 17b destroy serum: Choice (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_17b_destroy_serum.ethics.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If the system picks someone who can't say no for an experiment, that's not consent. It's just convenient material that was given a human name.
Quest trial nataly 01: End (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_trial_nataly_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The data matches. I'm still afraid of the conclusions. But now, at least I know exactly what I'm afraid of.
Quest trial nataly 01: Start (1)
  • नैटली ब्रूक्स<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_trial_nataly_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm holding onto the facts. They're the only thing that isn't shifting yet. Let's gather the data without panicking. Nathan, I need you to see all of it with your own eyes.

<en> Story dialogue (26)

Quest main 14: End (9)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I've known about the relay for a long time, but I couldn't fix it alone. Maya and I were looking for a safe place. If the offer still stands, we'd like to join your bunker.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.end.05.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I have everything for now, thanks. When did you last get some sleep yourself?
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.13.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Actually, we could try to learn more about it right now. There are several mysterious laboratories in the metro. They're surely connected to the system somehow.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.14.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Only, nobody has gone down there in a long time. And not because it's empty.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_14.end.20.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I think your group could get in there and study the laboratories. I know technology well, and I'll help you get access to the computers.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_14.end.22.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Most likely, it means that if we don't finish the task in time, the system will hand it to another group. By the way, that's exactly how I found you.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.24.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The task to repair the trade terminal was originally given to the leader of my group, but when only Maya and I were left, a time limit appeared on the task.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.end.25.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file When time ran out, the system took the task back and said it would hand it to another group.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→एमिली रिवर्सquest_main_14.end.26.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file That's why I waited near the terminal, to see who would come. I had nowhere else to go anyway.
Quest main 14: Start (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट→नेथन कोलquest_main_14.meeting.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm Seraphina. This is Maya. We were hiding nearby, waiting to see who would answer the signal.
Quest main 25: End (4)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_25.end.12.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file As long as its conditions help us survive, refusing looks like an expensive gesture, I'd first see what it's after.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_25.end.26.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Or we'll get false data, deliberately left for the curious. Not every open door is a mistake.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→मार्कोस «मार्को» रोड्रिगेज़quest_main_25.end.31.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'd restore the terminals without interfering, not out of trust, because of the cost of a mistake.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_25.end.32.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It's your call, Nathan. Do we fix the network or use the failure?
Quest personal sera 01: End (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good work! Tonight, there will be a few more living faces in the bunker.
Quest personal sera 01: Start (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A group of civilians is stuck in the tunnel. If we're late, all that's left will be marks on the wall. We'll make it if we leave right now. Are you with me?
Quest personal sera 02: End (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The perimeter held. We made it through this night.
Quest personal sera 02: Start (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The night wave will be hard. You know what's more dangerous than the enemy outside? Panic inside. Everyone's scared, but let people see us calm.
Quest personal sera 03: Choice (2)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_03.choice.00.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I led 19 people here. On the third night, I sealed the blast door while 6 were still outside. 13 lived to see morning. I remember every number and almost nothing before that night.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_03.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Now you know. I can live with any decision, whether we tell them or not. The question is whether the others can.
Quest personal sera 03: Cutscene (2)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_03.observer.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, don't go. I don't think it's me talking right now.
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Angry→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_03.observer.06.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Enough. This is my voice. From here on, I speak.
Quest personal sera 03: End (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I understand. Whatever we choose, there's no way back now.
Quest personal sera 03: Start (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_sera_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file What we hide from people still weighs on them. The only question is whether to tell the truth now or hold the ranks.
Quest trial sera 01: End (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइटखुश→नेथन कोलquest_trial_sera_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Clean. You moved like you'd been doing this your whole life. Where did you learn that?
Quest trial sera 01: Start (1)
  • सेराफ़िना «सेरा» नाइट→नेथन कोलquest_trial_sera_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file A silent raid, Nathan. We go in, take them out one by one, not a sound. One step wrong and the whole sector wakes up.

<en> Story dialogue (32)

Quest ending body: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म→नेथन कोलquest_ending_body.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The stand is powered. The materials are in place. David checked it. The personality transfers whole and only once. The rest is your call.
Quest ending body: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म→नेथन कोलquest_ending_body.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll build the body stand, but not out of thin air. Four memory cores, four sets of lab equipment and a running generator. David will verify the transfer afterwards. One personality, no backups.
Quest main 18: Step (3)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Afraid→नेथन कोलquest_main_18.oliver_meet.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Wait! Don't shoot! I'm not with them! They dragged me along with the convoy to fix their engines at gunpoint!
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_main_18.oliver_meet.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Oliver, power systems, motors, anything that hums. I've got nowhere to go. They burned my workshop, and alone I won't last out here till nightfall.
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_18.oliver_meet.05.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Generators are my thing. Lead the way. Just let me pull a few parts off their truck. They'll come in handy.
Quest main 19: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_19.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It's down. And it went down right. I saw where the hydraulics leak and where the controller melts. The MK 1.5 was a draft. The next mech won't repeat these mistakes.
Quest main 19: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_19.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The MEC MK 1.5 is my prototype. I was building it long before I joined you. When the system came, it went autonomous and now it runs the industrial zone. We lure it with the transmitter and take it down.
Quest main 23: Choice (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_23.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's just one panel, but it can be shut down three ways, quietly by the safe sequence, by the standard procedure, or by an emergency reset that risks the alarm.
Quest main 23: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_23.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It worked. The passage is open. The sector can breathe again. I admit it. I had no faith in that panel.
Quest main 23: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_23.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The laboratory is held by a single main panel. Natalie is already inside the sector. We'll get to her and lift the lockdown on site.
Quest main 34: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_34.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The mineral fits, we'll hold the grid, and you're fine from the lab, Dr. Liang is already asking for a corner to do research.
Quest main 34: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_34.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need a rare mineral for a new build. Without it, we won't hold the power grid. One more thing. There's a signal beeping from a locked lab at the same spot. How much time to spend on it is your call.
Quest main 36: End (2)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_main_36.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, you saved my project, and maybe the whole bunker.
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_36.end.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file One more thing. While the mech was in combat mode, it caught a packet from the system, the core's coordinates and a list of priority targets. Do we follow them?
Quest main 36: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_36.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file MEC 3.9 is in combat mode. If it breaks loose, the sector won't hold. I'll hold the circuit, you keep your distance.
Quest main 40: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म→नेथन कोलquest_main_40.end.stay.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file That's it. Earth is out of there. Cultivation. No support, no crossings to other worlds. The ruins and monsters stayed. Well, we fix it ourselves.
Quest personal oliver 01: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The generator is running smoothly. No, don't add more load since it worked. I'll check it myself. You can go to bed. Someone has to.
Quest personal oliver 01: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need the Nano Generator's calibration profile from the city terminal. Building without it means guessing when everything will burn. Choose a mode, and keep in mind, maybe it'll hold is not a calculation.
Quest personal oliver 02: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The circuit survived the test. Seriously, for the first time in two days, my hands aren't shaking.
Quest personal oliver 02: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Raiders have reached the port relays. The first version of the circuit is already on its last legs. One lucky shot and it's dark again. I'm tired of fixing disasters at the last moment.
Quest personal oliver 03: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Done. The lights are holding. And for the first time, it feels like we're not just retreating.
Quest personal oliver 03: Start (5)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_03.start.profile.caution.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Last time, we limited the power for the sake of stability. There's less margin, but the overheat protection should withstand a long load.
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_03.start.profile.dare.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We kept the boosted profile. There'll be more than enough power, but one prolonged surge could overheat the whole circuit.
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_03.start.profile.direct.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Last time, we chose the balanced profile. Today, we'll find out whether standard protection is enough under a real attack.
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_03.start.profile.fallback.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The record of the first profile wasn't saved. I'm taking balance settings, standard power and standard protection. No guesswork on a peak launch.
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_oliver_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It'll get hot on the tower, but if the backup circuit comes to life, we won't go blind at the worst possible hour.
Quest side mvp 16a rescue engineers: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The group is alive. Now we have the brains to keep the lights on longer than one night.
Quest side mvp 16a rescue engineers: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_16a_rescue_engineers.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If we lose these engineers, we simply won't survive the next blackout.
Quest side mvp 16b secure reactor: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The grid held, but it looks like we won't get back those who were waiting for us in the Metro.
Quest side mvp 16b secure reactor: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_side_mvp_16b_secure_reactor.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file One more surge and the reactor goes down. And the whole bunker with it. We need to stabilise the node now.
Quest trial oliver 01: End (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मखुश→नेथन कोलquest_trial_oliver_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The circuit held. I admit, I was afraid it would burn up along with half my calculations.
Quest trial oliver 01: Start (1)
  • ऑलिवर स्टॉर्म<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_trial_oliver_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Let's test the emergency power circuit. If it fails, half the bunker will be left in the dark. Nathan, if this works, we'll buy time.

<en> Story dialogue (9)

Quest main 24: Choice (1)
  • जैकब मार्श<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_24.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Stop. I'm not with them. One more step with that weapon, and I'll decide you came to finish me off.
Quest main 24: End (1)
  • जैकब मार्श→नेथन कोलquest_main_24.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You could have finished me off. You didn't. I'll remember that. The port access card survived. They're yours, if there's room in the bunker for me too. Fair deal.
Quest main 24: Start (1)
  • जैकब मार्श<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_24.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file If anyone can hear me, my name is Jacob Marsh. The bandits have me pinned down downtown. Their empty posts are bait. The shooters are waiting inside the camp.
Quest main 30: Choice (1)
  • जैकब मार्श<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_30.choice.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two sources. One talks too much. The other leads in silence. Which one do we take?
Quest main 30: End (1)
  • जैकब मार्श→नेथन कोलquest_main_30.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good. Now it's not just tall tales. It's a point on the map.
Quest main 30: Start (2)
  • जैकब मार्श→नेथन कोलquest_main_30.start.00.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The port can wait. That camp wasn't the whole gang. Their depot is in the industrial zone. While they hold it, there's no safe route to the port or to your bunker.
  • जैकब मार्श<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_30.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need to scout the industrial zone. The Bandits warehouse could be a myth, or it could be a knife at our backs. Confirm the coordinates. If it's guarded, take the guards out before word spreads.
Quest main 31: End (1)
  • जैकब मार्श→नेथन कोलquest_main_31.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Job done. Today, the city won't slam the door in our face.
Quest main 31: Start (1)
  • जैकब मार्श<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_31.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We intercepted their chatter. The Bandits have stockpiled sabotage charges in their camp. If they spread them around the city, the fires and panic will reach our people. We need to hit the stockpile first.

<en> Story dialogue (9)

Quest main 32: End (1)
  • इंडिया रायन→नेथन कोलquest_main_32.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'm India. That signal was the only way to call for help. If there's a place for me in the bunker, I'll earn it.
Quest personal india 01: End (1)
  • इंडिया रायनखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_india_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We got to the hangar and made it back out. And you keep the pace pretty well! Just don't tell me I'm supposed to sit quietly for a week now.
Quest personal india 01: Start (1)
  • इंडिया रायन<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_india_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My plane is still in the hangar. While everyone else decides whether it's safe to go there, I'm going to get to it. Will you come with me? I won't promise a quiet stroll.
Quest personal india 02: End (1)
  • इंडिया रायनखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_india_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The window's narrow, but it's there. Narrow ones are my favourite. Nobody but me can squeeze through.
Quest personal india 02: Start (1)
  • इंडिया रायन<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_india_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I won't take the plane up blind. The mountain weather station may still hold wind data by altitude and the window between weather fronts. Once we get the data, we'll decide whether to take off.
Quest personal india 03: End (1)
  • इंडिया रायन<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_india_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file That's it. The ribbon went with the water, not the wind. My sister would have laughed at that. Thanks for standing there and not saying too much.
Quest personal india 03: Start (1)
  • इंडिया रायन<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_india_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My sister always asked me to fly over the bay and drop her ribbon over the water. They won't give me the sky right now. Will you walk with me to the pier? I'll say goodbye on the ground. Just once.
Quest trial india 01: End (1)
  • इंडिया रायनखुश→नेथन कोलquest_trial_india_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file On the edge, yes, but not over it. So the route can be repeated without losing people.
Quest trial india 01: Start (1)
  • इंडिया रायन<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_trial_india_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The runway corridor is all pace, risk and clean movement. Nathan, let's fly low and come back alive.

<en> Story dialogue (30)

Quest ending body: Step (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_ending_body.continuity.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The transfer preserves the single core. It doesn't create a copy of Nora. The body can be repaired. The core can't. If it's lost, no backup and no Apex chassis will replace it.
Quest ending evidence: Step (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_ending_evidence.david.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file My field data confirms Natalie's archive. Phoenix's spread will overload the connected cultivation nodes. The danger to thousands of worlds is real.
Quest ending transfer: End (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_ending_transfer.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The package is assembled. Only the signature is left. The gateway is still closed. That part isn't my job.
Quest ending transfer: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_ending_transfer.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I'll assemble the core transfer package. I need eight microchips and your player signature. It won't open the gateway. The arbiter holds it. The package will simply be ready.
Quest main 25: End (3)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_main_25.end.02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file For a while, I need a roof and a workbench, and you seem to need someone who understands signals. We'll talk about more later.
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_main_25.end.10.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Does the system often push the maintenance of its own infrastructure onto you?
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→लियाम ओ'कॉनरquest_main_25.end.15.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file And what if we refuse? It's important to understand where an offer ends and coercion begins.
Quest main 28: End (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_main_28.end.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You have the equipment. I have questions about this signal. Let me in and I'll stay. I work alone.
Quest main 28: Step (2)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_main_28.beacon.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, it's David. I've got the beacon on the air. Give me a minute. I'll tune the frequency so it carries far.
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_main_28.beacon.03.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Done. Strange. Someone's answering on the beacon frequency. A repeating tune. Sounds like a saxophone. I'll record it. We'll sort it out later.
Quest main 32: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_main_32.start.00.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I've worked out the tune from the beacon frequency. It's not interference. It's being broadcast from a hangar at the edge of the airport. Someone has been calling for days.
Quest main 40: End (1)
  • डेविड किम→ऑलिवर स्टॉर्मquest_main_40.end.stay_scope.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Not Earth, Oliver, our city. Beyond its edge, the system watches the way it always has.
Quest personal david 01: End (1)
  • डेविड किमखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Both jammers are off. Comparing the logs before and after. There. The gaps aren't random. Every night the same stretch is cut out, about 12 minutes. Don't close this file.
Quest personal david 01: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Gaps keep repeating in the logs. It looks like interference, but it's not proof yet. There are two jammers at the airport. Shut both down. I need a clean signal, not another theory.
Quest personal david 02: End (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The weather terminal was the node. It survived the first day because someone kept it running. I have the snapshot.
Quest personal david 02: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I found a node that shouldn't have survived the first day of the apocalypse. There are answers there. And, most likely, problems.
Quest personal david 03: End (2)
  • डेविड किम<en> Sad→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You finished the cross check. The fake commands are slotted in between the real ones, as if someone learned from our decisions. Now we have proof, and a problem we can't just hide.
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Your call, Nathan. Hand the evidence to the whole team, lock the archive, and pretend we noticed nothing, or warn people and burn the channel. After this choice, the investigation won't be the same.
Quest personal david 03: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_david_03.offer.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The data from the surviving node is already in the bunker. There are three layers of commands inside, and fakes are woven in between the real packets. Run the archive through the sync terminal. After the comparison, we'll decide what to do with it.
Quest personal nathan 01: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_01.start.00.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Nathan, your terminal brought up the protocol of the past again. After that voice on the channel, I wouldn't ignore it.
Quest personal nathan 02: End (3)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Received. The data doesn't match everything you remember. That's no reason to delete it.
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_02.end.confess_02.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Why?
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_02.end.confess_04.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Then, it didn't make contact by chance.
Quest personal nathan 02: Start (1)
  • डेविड किम→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nathan_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There are servers in the old lab sector marked with your project's label. I came across them in the node registry while looking for something else. They haven't been wiped yet.
Quest personal nora 00: End (1)
  • डेविड किम<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_nora_00.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I recorded the conversation. That voice came through three nodes at once. People don't talk like that, not even the ones we loved.
Quest personal nora 00: Start (1)

<en> Story dialogue (21)

Quest main mountain lab: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग→नेथन कोलquest_main_mountain_lab.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Observation subject. Isolated under system protocol. I wasn't locked in. I was left there so they could watch what the field would do to me.
Quest main mountain lab: Start (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग→नेथन कोलquest_main_mountain_lab.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file You asked who locked me in. I want to know too. The door log records everything. Who closed it, when, and on whose orders. Will you take me to the entrance?
Quest personal liang 01: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The containers weren't opened, there's no reaction inside, and yet the composition is already different. Either two instruments are lying the same way, or the sample was subject to different conditions along the way. I like the second option far less.
Quest personal liang 01: Start (4)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_01.start.response.calculation.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Good. Double labeling removes half the errors before analysis even starts. I'm ready to work with a protocol like that.
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_01.start.response.care.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Without field samples, the filter will remain a guess, but if the background goes beyond the limits, come back. Living data is better than dead heroes.
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_01.start.response.challenge.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file We need the field test, but caustic dust doesn't respect confidence. Stay within the protocol's limits.
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file I need two identical samples from the same spot. Seal the first on-site, the second one minute later. Yesterday, a grain of metal changed its mass without any reaction. Once is an error. Twice is data.
Quest personal liang 02: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The data matches. A single rhythm changes the dust in the cartridge and drives the acid glands beyond their limits. We're not looking at two dangers, but one command in two different forms.
Quest personal liang 02: Start (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The dust changes even after I remove the cartridge. Once is an error. Twice is data. Now it repeats in every cartridge. A rule we can't yet measure directly is at work around us.
Quest personal liang 03: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The circuit worked. Past its edge, the changes came back. So we weren't suppressing tissue, but the rule that rebuilds it. I'm staying. The team needs a biologist who can argue with more than just time.
Quest personal liang 03: Start (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liang_03.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file There's no stable chemical cause in the samples. The acid appears when the field gives the body the same order over and over again. I've built a circuit that should knock this rhythm off.
Quest personal liu 01: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liu_01.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The recordings diverged again, but only after the observer changed. It's not proof of an answer, but now we have a reproducible question.
Quest personal liu 01: Start (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liu_01.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file Two cameras watch the same object in the same second. On the first, it's whole. On the second, there's already a cavity inside. The time matches, the angles are verified. So, the variable is the observer.
Quest personal liu 02: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liu_02.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The prediction broke off exactly at the moment of decision. The model kept calculating options, but none of them described what you did.
Quest personal liu 02: Start (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांग<en> Doubt→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liu_02.start.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file The model knows your pace, your distance, and even the moment you decide to cover someone else. Don't try to be faster. Do something that doesn't exist in its rules yet.
Quest personal liu 03: End (1)
  • सुन वेई «डॉक» लियांगखुश→नेथन कोलquest_personal_liu_03.end.01.ogg<en> Heard in the sound file It copied every known decision, but the rule you created at the moment of choice remained an empty space for it. I can measure that gap, but I can't explain it yet.
